study_label: Fresh human-first Gemma controlled-edit candidate reranking pilot

inputs.case_id: sha256(utf8(corpus_id + NUL + sent_id + NUL + edit_type + NUL + one_based_source_position))
inputs.order: corpus_order, byte-frozen source row order, then candidate_slot 1..3
inputs.generation_field: sentence_original only; author edit columns are not loaded into generation objects

runtime.license: Apache-2.0 as emitted by ollama show
runtime.seed_derivation: first 31 bits of sha256(utf8(master_seed + ':' + seed_namespace + ':' + case_id + ':' + candidate_slot + ':' + attempt_index)), big-endian
runtime.residency: Stop qwen3:14b, gpt-oss:20b, and gemma4:12b; warm exact Gemma tag with a non-project fixture; require exactly the pinned Gemma digest resident before and after all project calls; every response model must match; stop Gemma and require empty ollama ps at close. Preserve all installed models.

prompts.system: Generate one controlled rewrite for a sentence-specificity study. Preserve the sentence's main meaning, factual commitments, polarity, modality, and communicative intent. Make only the requested kind of change. Do not assume hidden context or invent unsupported facts. Return exactly one grammatical sentence in the required JSON field and no explanation.
prompts.blindness: No corpus, identifiers, author edit, prior model output, prior attempt, proxy, predictor score, rubric score, human label, or review information enters a request.

integrity_inclusion.retention: For each slot, retain the first attempt passing all integrity checks. Retry with an independently derived seed and fresh context only after interface/integrity failure. Never repair, rank, or manually select. Stop with no packet if any slot remains missing after three attempts.

automatic_proxy_audit.timing: After 180/180 generation completeness and before packet release; never gates, ranks, excludes, or alters a candidate.
automatic_proxy_audit.saved_fields: candidate_id, pass/fail, reason codes, and proxy component metrics in the ignored key-side artifact

scoring.timing: Only after generation is complete; scores never affect inclusion or reviewer presentation.
scoring.coverage_gate: Exact one-to-one finite in-range scores for every original and candidate under every primary scorer; exact saved model/checkpoint/image identities; no retraining. Otherwise no packet.

selection_policies.candidate_pool: exactly three retained candidate slots for each source
selection_policies.rule: For add_specific select greatest specificity-aligned candidate-minus-original delta; for de_specify select smallest specificity-aligned candidate-minus-original delta; for irrelevant_rewrite select smallest absolute aligned delta. GranuScore aligned score equals negative native score. Ties select lowest candidate_slot.
selection_policies.consensus_rule: Within each source and direction, rank candidate slots independently under SpeciTeller, Ko run01, run02, run03, and aligned GranuScore using the same direction rule; sum ranks; select the lowest sum, then lowest candidate_slot. Secondary only.
selection_policies.evaluation_boundary: Policies are evaluated only against completed blinded human scores, never against the metric that selected them. Selection mappings remain private until all 180 reviews are frozen.

blinding.review_id: HFE- plus first 12 RFC4648 base32 characters without padding of sha256(seed:namespace:candidate_id)
blinding.side_assignment: Within each hidden corpus-by-direction cell, sort candidates by sha256(seed:candidate_id); candidate is A for the first exact half and B for the second, giving exact 50/50 in every even cell and 90/90 overall.

score_values.X: not comparable because meaning/factuality/grammar is not acceptably preserved

blinding.key: Ignored reversible mapping with case/candidate identity, source and candidate hashes/text, hidden cell/direction, A/B role, slot, attempts, proxy audit, scorer values, and policy mappings. Do not open or expose after construction until all 180 ratings are frozen.

release_gate: private reversible key bijection and hashes pass
CSV and XLSX content equivalence passes

outputs.release_boundary: All text-bearing generation, candidate, scoring, key, and review packet artifacts remain ignored. Track only portable method/code/tests and content-free aggregate counts/hashes.
